versions.summary: Uses a custom always-on-top dialog for the single-instance warning instead of a standard message box.

items: Changed the single-instance warning to use a custom Press Layouts dialog that stays always on top until dismissed, instead of the default message box.

versions.summary: Hardens the single-instance launcher guard so duplicate starts now reliably refocus the existing window and show the one-instance warning.

items: Fixed main launcher single-instance enforcement by replacing the previous startup guard with a stronger Windows mutex plus activation listener approach.
Fixed duplicate Press Layouts launches so the already-running launcher or startup dialog is brought to the front and shows a one-instance warning instead of allowing another main launcher to open.

versions.summary: Limits Press Layouts to one launcher instance and brings the existing launcher to the front when another start is attempted.

items: Changed startup so only one Press Layouts main launcher instance can run at a time.
Changed second-launch attempts so the existing Press Layouts window is brought to the front and shows a message that only one main launcher instance can be run at a time.

versions.summary: Makes the update notification open above every window and stay always on top until dismissed.

items: Changed the newer-version update notification so it opens above all other windows and remains always on top until it is closed or Restart is chosen.

versions.summary: Removes the main launcher preview pane label/header entirely while keeping the preview resize handle intact.

items: Changed the main launcher preview pane to remove the Preview label/header entirely while keeping the resize sash and preview area behavior the same.

versions.summary: Tightens the main launcher preview title area by replacing the bulky label-frame header with a smaller compact header.

items: Changed the main launcher preview pane to use a compact Preview header instead of the larger default labelframe title area so more height is available for the preview image.

versions.summary: Removes more wasted vertical space around the main launcher button row so the preview gets more usable height.

items: Changed the main launcher upper pane padding so there is less blank space below the button row before the preview sash.
Changed the main launcher button row spacing so the buttons sit much closer to both the treeview and the preview sash.
Changed the main launcher preview frame padding slightly so a little more of the lower pane height goes to the preview area itself.

versions.summary: Tightens the launcher button-to-preview spacing and makes the database selector remember its window position.

items: Changed the main launcher button row to reduce the space below it so the preview pane gets a little more vertical room.
Changed the admin Live/Test database selector window so it now remembers its last window position like the other remembered windows.

versions.summary: Condenses the launcher status line, moves database connection status into DB Maintenance, and gives the main preview more room.

items: Changed the main launcher top row so the Live/Test database label, (ADMIN) flag, username, and version appear together on one line at the right side opposite the Layouts label.
Changed the main launcher filters so Search now sits on its own row, while Issue Date appears before Press and Format on the filter row.
Changed the main launcher action-button row padding to 10 pixels above and below so the preview area has a little more room.
Moved the pulsing database connection status bar out of the main launcher preview area and into the DB Maintenance window.

versions.summary: Shows the Live/Test database label only for admins and places it on the same line as the admin status flag.

items: Changed the main launcher top-right status so the Live/Test database label is shown only for admins.
Changed the admin status area so the Live/Test database label appears on the same line as the (ADMIN) label instead of on its own row.

versions.summary: First release of the shared launcher using compiled binaries.

items: Added the shared launcher executable with compiled binaries.

versions.summary: Update-detected restarts now relaunch Press Layouts through the shared launcher path.

items: Changed the newer-version update dialog so choosing Restart relaunches Press Layouts from L:\PressLayouts\launcher\press_layouts_launcher.exe when that launcher is available.
Changed restart requests triggered by shared restart flows to fall back to the existing launcher-managed restart exit code only when the shared launcher executable cannot be started.

versions.summary: Bumped version to 1.2.28 for a new release with the same changelog as 1.2.27.

items: Added a launcher status indicator that shows whether Press Layouts is currently connected using the Live or Test database selection.
Changed EXE distribution startup so changelog.json is read from L:\changelog.json and the live database config is read from L:\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed admin startup for MBradbury so launch now prompts for Live or Test database selection, with Test using L:\working\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed restart after update checks and restart after database restore to relaunch L:\press_layout.exe instead of the extracted temporary runtime or a Python script.
Removed runtime dependency install checks and prompts from the EXE build since packaged distributions already contain the required dependencies.

versions.summary: Adds a visible live/test database indicator in the launcher and aligns EXE distribution settings with shared L:\ files and relaunch behavior.

items: Added a launcher status indicator that shows whether Press Layouts is currently connected using the Live or Test database selection.
Changed EXE distribution startup so changelog.json is read from L:\changelog.json and the live database config is read from L:\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed admin startup for MBradbury so launch now prompts for Live or Test database selection, with Test using L:\working\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed restart after update checks and restart after database restore to relaunch L:\press_layout.exe instead of the extracted temporary runtime or a Python script.
Removed runtime dependency install checks and prompts from the EXE build since packaged distributions already contain the required dependencies.

versions.summary: Uses icon.ico as the window icon for the launcher and child dialogs when the file is present beside the script.

items: Changed the launcher and child window creation flow to apply icon.ico from the script folder as the application window icon whenever the file is available.

versions.summary: Ensures monthly macro confirmation dialogs open large enough on first run so controls are not cut off.

items: Fixed the USAT Monthly, GRE Homefinder Monthly, and shared Sunday-only monthly macro confirmation dialogs so they auto-expand to fit their full content on first run instead of opening too short and cutting off controls.

versions.summary: Adds four new Sunday-only comics monthly macros for AUG, GRE, RAL, and USAT CO.

items: Added AUG COMICS Monthly, GRE COMICS Monthly, RAL COMICS Monthly, and USAT CO COMICS Monthly launcher macros for JSaalsaa and MBradbury by cloning the GRE Homefinder monthly Sunday-only workflow and pointing each macro at its matching regular.

Changed the shared Sunday-only monthly macro flow so GRE Homefinder and the new comics macros all use the same confirmation summary, separate layout and starter-sheet print options, progress window, and end-of-run report structure.

versions.summary: Splits monthly macro printing options so layouts and starter sheets can be printed independently.

items: Changed the USAT Monthly and GRE Homefinder Monthly confirmation dialogs so Print generated output now uses separate checkboxes for layouts and starter sheets, allowing either option or both to be selected.

Changed the USAT Monthly and GRE Homefinder Monthly macro runs so layout printing and starter-sheet printing now follow the individual confirmation checkbox selections instead of a single combined print toggle.

versions.summary: Cloned layouts now keep the existing product name while clearing the issue date for the new copy.

items: Changed layout cloning from the main launcher so new cloned layouts keep the source layout's product name instead of clearing it, while still blanking the issue date for the new copy.

versions.summary: Adds a GRE Homefinder Monthly launcher macro for Sunday-only layout generation and printing.

items: Added a GRE Homefinder Monthly macro for JSaalsaa and MBradbury that clones the USAT monthly workflow using the regular GRE Homefinder source.
Configured the GRE Homefinder Monthly macro to generate layouts only for Sunday issue dates in the selected month and optionally print each layout with its starter sheet.

versions.summary: Fixes layout save template prompts so matching database templates are recognized.

items: Fixed layout save/save-as template prompting so matching templates stored in the PostgreSQL template collection are recognized instead of only checking legacy flat-file template JSON files.
Kept the imposition-name and structural template matching fallback so renamed templates still suppress the unnecessary save-template prompt.

versions.summary: Fixes starter-sheet font helper references introduced by the USAT monthly print additions.

items: Fixed the shared starter-sheet renderer helpers to call the existing _render_load_starter_font function so editor diagnostics no longer flag _load_starter_font as undefined.
Kept the USAT monthly print helpers aligned with the existing starter-sheet rendering code path so printing support continues to compile cleanly.

versions.summary: Fixes USAT monthly printing so selected generated layouts and starter sheets are actually sent to the default printer.

items: Fixed the USAT monthly macro so choosing the Print option now actually prints each generated layout and starter sheet during the run instead of only recording the setting in the confirmation dialog.
Fixed the USAT monthly report counts so printed layouts, printed starter sheets, and print failures now reflect the actual work performed by the macro.

versions.summary: Adds optional USAT monthly printing for generated layouts and starter sheets.

items: Added a Print option to the USAT monthly confirmation dialog so users can choose whether to print generated output before running the macro.
Added automatic USAT monthly printing that sends 5 copies of each generated layout and 1 copy of each generated starter sheet to the default printer when the Print option is selected.
Updated the USAT monthly completion report to show printed layouts, printed starter sheets, and any print failures alongside creation, overwrite, skip, and preview results.

versions.summary: Adds a progress window and report dialog to the USAT monthly macro.

items: Added a progress window to the USAT monthly macro that shows the current issue date, regular name, target filename, and overall item progress while layouts are being generated.
Added a report dialog at the end of the USAT monthly macro run that lists processed issue dates plus the layouts that were created, overwritten, skipped, and any preview failures.

versions.summary: Adds a USAT monthly confirmation summary and overwrite-or-skip handling for existing layouts.

items: Added a confirmation summary before the USAT monthly macro runs showing the selected month, weekday issue-date count, layout count, and how many target layouts already exist.
Added overwrite and skip options for existing target layouts in the USAT monthly macro run confirmation dialog.
Updated the USAT monthly macro completion flow so results are shown in a detailed report after generation instead of a simple count-only finish message.

versions.summary: Adds launcher macros with a USAT monthly generator for selected users.

items: Added a clickable username link in the top right corner of the main launcher for JSaalsaa and MBradbury that opens a Macros dialog with a Run button.
Added a USAT monthly macro with a month/year picker that generates USAT layouts for every weekday issue date in the chosen month from the matching regulars.
Configured the USAT monthly macro so Monday through Thursday issues use the USAT A&B and USAT C&D regulars, while Friday issues use the USAT A&D and USAT B&C regulars.

versions.summary: New Layout now remembers whether each user last used Standard mode or From Regular mode.

items: Changed the New Layout window to save and restore whether each user last used Standard mode or From Regular mode.
Stored the per-user New Layout mode preference in the same user-specific window state JSON used for geometry and other remembered view settings.

versions.summary: Saves and restores each user's treeview view state, including expansion, selection, scroll, sort, and column sizes.

items: Changed the main launcher, New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor to save and restore each user's treeview expand/collapse state, selected row, scroll position, sort order, and column widths.
Stored the per-user treeview view state alongside the existing user-specific window size and position data without letting geometry saves overwrite the treeview settings.

versions.summary: Adds the current username to the top-right launcher status area.

items: Added a username label in the top right corner of the main launcher above the version label.

versions.summary: Fixes restore backup reading so transactional restore no longer depends on pathlib.Path being imported.

items: Fixed database restore to read the selected SQL backup file with standard file I/O instead of pathlib.Path so restore no longer fails with "name "Path" is not defined".
Added target database and schema details to restore logging to make future restore troubleshooting faster.

versions.summary: Fixes restore failures caused by mapped-drive backup paths in the transactional wrapper.

items: Changed database restore so the temporary transactional wrapper now embeds the selected backup SQL directly instead of referencing it with a psql include path.
Fixed restore failures that could occur when backups were stored on mapped drives such as L:\SQL Server\Backups.

versions.summary: Adds last-success DB timing, makes restore transactional, and reduces psycopg editor warnings.

items: Added the last successful database check time to the launcher status area.
Changed database restore to use a transactional psql wrapper so a restore failure does not leave the Press Layouts schema dropped or half-restored.
Updated restore and maintenance messaging to point to L:\SQL Server\PostgreSQL\bin for psql and pg_dump.
Switched PostgreSQL driver loading to importlib-based imports in Press Layouts and the import helper script to reduce unresolved psycopg warnings in editors such as VS Code / Pylance.

versions.summary: Moves the launcher DB status below the preview, adds pulsing status, and expands maintenance tool discovery.

items: Moved the main launcher database status bar below the preview area.
Updated the launcher database status indicator to pulse green when connected and pulse red when offline.
Expanded the offline database status text to include the last connection error message when one is available.
Updated PostgreSQL maintenance tool discovery to prefer binaries under L:\SQL Server\PostgreSQL\bin.

versions.summary: Adds a launcher database status bar and improves backup defaults.

items: Updated DB Maintenance backups to default to L:\SQL Server\Backups with a timestamped SQL filename.
Added a main launcher database status bar that shows the configured server and database name.
Added a green or red database status indicator that reflects whether Press Layouts can currently connect to the configured PostgreSQL server and database.

versions.summary: Removes the reclaim placeholder and expands DB Maintenance backup and restore support.

items: Removed the Compress / Reclaim placeholder action from DB Maintenance.
Updated PostgreSQL client tool discovery so backup and restore look in PATH and under L:\SQL Server for pg_dump and psql.
Implemented database restore so it now resets the Press Layouts schema, imports the selected SQL backup with psql, refreshes launcher caches, and offers to restart the application afterward.

versions.summary: Moves admin maintenance actions into a dedicated DB Maintenance dialog and removes launcher regen buttons.

items: Removed the Regen Preview button from the main launcher, Template Editor, and Regular Editor.
Removed the Cleanup button from the main launcher and replaced the admin-only maintenance area with a new DB Maintenance button.
Added a DB Maintenance dialog for admins that includes the existing cleanup workflow plus database health check, backup, restore guidance, optimization, and compress/reclaim-space guidance actions.

versions.summary: Adds user-approved dependency installation prompts for startup and restart.

items: Added startup dependency checks for required packages such as Pillow and a PostgreSQL driver.
Added an Install prompt that lets users approve one-click dependency installation before the application continues loading.
Added the same dependency check and install prompt to the changelog-based restart flow.
Updated startup and restart handling so the application stops cleanly when required dependencies are missing and the user declines installation.

versions.summary: Default first-column sorting now shows correctly on initial treeview load.

items: Set the main launcher, New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews to default-sort by their first column on initial load.
Fixed the initial sort indicator display so the first column now shows its ascending indicator immediately instead of waiting for the first click.

versions.summary: Fixed first-column sorting across the main and editor treeviews.

items: Fixed first-column sorting in the main launcher treeview so clicking Product now sorts correctly.
Fixed first-column sorting in the New Layout window so Template Name and Product sort correctly in the template and regular pickers.
Fixed first-column sorting in the Template Editor and Regular Editor treeviews.
Updated first-column headings to show the same ascending and descending sort indicators used by the other sortable columns.

versions.summary: Migrates layouts, templates, regulars, and previews to PostgreSQL with multi-user edit awareness.

items: Added PostgreSQL-backed storage for layouts, templates, regulars, and preview images.
Added automatic database and schema bootstrap using the configured PostgreSQL connection settings.
Added multi-user record-open awareness that warns when another user already has a record open and keeps a heartbeat while the record is being edited.
Added a one-time import path to move existing flat-file layouts, templates, regulars, and previews into PostgreSQL.
Changed the application to load and save all layout data directly from PostgreSQL instead of the Layouts, Regular, and Templates flat-file folders.
Changed Save As behavior so users provide a database record name instead of browsing a flat-file folder.
Updated preview storage so preview images are stored and retrieved from PostgreSQL alongside each record.

versions.summary: Fixed New Layout templates so Last Changed By shows cached template attribution instead of Unknown.

items: Fixed the New Layout template picker so template rows now carry forward cached last_changed_by values instead of dropping them and displaying Unknown.
Fixed New Layout template search and sorting so the Last Changed By column participates correctly.

versions.summary: Added per-user last-changed tracking for layouts, regulars, and templates, and surfaced it in treeviews.

items: Added best-effort logged-in Windows username capture for layout, regular, and template saves.
Added a Last Changed By column to the main launcher, New Layout picker, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews.
Tracked JSON saves in Layouts, Regular, and Templates now stamp last_changed_by and refresh saved_at when the file is written, including Touch ALL and preview-related metadata writes.

versions.summary: Added a Save as Regular action to the layout editor.

items: Added a Save as Regular button to the layout editor that saves the current layout as a regular using the regular suggested filename in the regulars directory.

versions.summary: Touch ALL and save/save-as now share the same NYT and CO-aware USAT starter-format rules.

items: Updated Touch ALL so layouts whose product name contains NYT are set to the NYT starter format, and layouts whose product name contains USAT without the standalone word CO are set to the USAT starter format; all other layouts keep their existing starter format.

Updated layout save/save-as prompting so the USAT starter suggestion only appears when the product name contains USAT and does not contain the standalone word CO, while NYT still suggests the NYT starter format.

versions.summary: Audited non-editor save paths and hardened starter format persistence across both editor and touch workflows.

items: Updated collect_layout_data so non-template saves persist starter_format directly whenever the live or headless context provides it, reducing reliance on follow-up file rewrites.
Updated headless layout contexts used by touch/cleanup workflows to carry starter_format, hardening future non-editor save paths against dropping that persisted layout field.

versions.summary: Touch ALL now preserves each layout's existing starter format instead of resetting it to Standard.

items: Updated touch/cleanup normalization so layout files keep their existing starter_format value when Touch ALL re-saves them, preventing layouts from being reset back to Standard.

versions.summary: Section renames in the layout editor now resolve unit assignments by displayed section names before canonical section parsing.

items: Made section renaming in the layout editor more reliable by resolving unit section assignments against the actual displayed section names first, preventing custom letter-based section names from being misread as canonical section ids and unintentionally clearing or misrouting unit assignments.

versions.summary: Previews and printed layouts now share the same render path.

items: Updated the layout editor so both preview images and printed layouts now use the same print-image renderer, with the preview continuing to show only the top 50 percent of that rendered image.

versions.summary: Printed layouts now use the same taller unit color-box height as previews.

items: Updated the print renderer used by the layout editor so the color boxes below each unit use the same taller height based on grid cell size that previews already use.

versions.summary: Color swatch boxes under each unit now render taller in previews and printed layouts.

items: In the preview and printed layout renderers, the color boxes below each unit now use a height based on the layout grid cell height so they appear vertically larger and closer to the same height as the unit grid boxes.

versions.summary: Fixed grouped launcher folder counts so template and regular treeviews load correctly again.

items: Resolved a group-count initialization error that could prevent the New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews from loading templates and regulars after the bold counted folder update.

versions.summary: Grouped treeviews now show bold counted folders, and the New Layout template list stretches correctly again.

items: Restored the New Layout template treeview layout so it stretches with the window again by reapplying the missing frame row and column weights.
Updated grouped rows in the main launcher, New Layout window, Template Editor, and Regular Editor to display bold folder-style labels with item counts for each press, format, and issue-date group.

versions.summary: Grouped fields now act only as folders while sortable columns focus on production details.

items: Updated the Template Editor and the New Layout template picker so press and format remain grouping folders only, while the sortable template columns are now Sections, Pages, and Last Saved.
Updated the Regular Editor and the New Layout regular picker so press and format remain grouping folders only, while the sortable regular columns are now Pages, Color Pages, Plates, and Last Saved.

Updated the main launcher so issue dates remain grouping folders only and the tree column now shows Product names for child rows while Press, Format, Pages, Color Pages, Plates, and Last Saved remain sortable.

versions.summary: New Layout launcher now groups template and regular pickers by press and format.

items: Updated the New Layout window so both the template picker and regular layout picker group rows by press and then by format, with all groups expanded by default.

versions.summary: Launcher trees now group layouts by issue date and templates and regulars by press and format.

items: Updated the main launcher treeview to group layouts under issue-date folders with tomorrow expanded by default and the remaining dates collapsed by default.
Updated the Template Editor and Regular Editor treeviews to group items first by press and then by format, with all groups expanded by default.

versions.summary: Cleanup Touch ALL now reapplies current imposition logic and renames corrected templates.

items: Updated Cleanup Touch ALL so existing layouts, regulars, and templates are re-saved using the current imposition logic, and templates are renamed to the corrected filename when the new imposition rule changes their name.

versions.summary: Imposition and template naming now infer virtual top rows for operator-side dinkies.

items: Updated imposition, template filenames, and template names so operator-side dinky units sort using an inferred virtual top row between the surrounding former/web units instead of the bottom-row page numbers.

versions.summary: Printed layouts no longer show the imposition line in either print render path.

items: Removed the Imposition line from the actual printed layout output and the headless print renderer used for generated previews.

versions.summary: Regular save filenames now use press/publication/section-page naming and first saves no longer prompt for a filename.

items: Updated regular save and save-as filename suggestions to use P# Publication SectionPages naming, omitting empty sections and joining populated sections with hyphens.
Updated Save in template, layout, and regular editors so a first-time save writes directly to the suggested filename without opening a filename confirmation dialog.

versions.summary: Save and Touch ALL now validate layouts, templates, and regulars with regular-mode issue date disabled.

items: Added save and Touch ALL validation for required issue date rules, required publication name rules, numeric-only grid cells, and section assignments based on whether the file is a layout, regular, or template.
Updated regular mode in the layout editor so the Issue Date field is disabled like template mode while still allowing blank issue dates for regular saves.
Updated Touch ALL so each layout, template, and regular file is validated before it is saved, while leaving starter format verification behavior unchanged for manual save and save-as.

versions.summary: Press unit grid fields now accept numbers only.

items: Updated all press unit grid cells so users can only type or paste numeric values, preventing letters and symbols from being entered.

versions.summary: Uppercase publication entry with starter format prompts for USAT and NYT saves.

items: Added a save and save-as prompt that offers to switch Starter to USAT when the publication name contains USAT and the current starter format is different.
Added a save and save-as prompt that offers to switch Starter to NYT when the publication name contains NYT and the current starter format is different.
Updated the publication name field in regular and layout editors to automatically convert text to all caps while typing and when loading saved layouts.
Updated starter sheet publication rendering, saved layout publication values, and layout filename suggestions to use uppercase publication names.

versions.summary: Starter sheet color change boxes expanded to every format with cleaner aligned sizing and placement.

items: Added Color Addition and Color Drop boxes to the Standard and USAT starter sheet formats.
Updated all three starter sheet formats so Color Addition and Color Drop match the size of Last Image and Last Plate and sit directly underneath them.
Adjusted the remaining USAT and NYT starter sheet boxes to align cleanly with the same left and right column widths used by the main starter sheet rows.

versions.summary: Automatic update checks with restart prompt for newer program versions.

items: Added an automatic changelog version check that runs every 10 minutes while the main launcher is open.
Added an update dialog that tells users when they are not running the latest version and reminds them to save their work before restarting.
Added Restart and Cancel buttons to the update dialog.
Updated the launcher restart flow so choosing Restart closes the current instance and relaunches the program using the latest Python files on disk.

versions.summary: Starter sheet refinements for publication header, total pages, and format-specific field adjustments

items: Added an auto-populated Total Pages field to the Standard, USAT, and NYT starter sheet formats.
Replaced the starter sheet title label on all three starter sheet formats with a full-width Publication box.
Updated the USAT starter sheet so the First Image box matches the Last Image box size and is positioned directly below it on the left side.
Removed the NYT CLOSE DETAILS header line from the NYT starter sheet format.

versions.summary: All new starter sheets for all 3 formats

items: Added all new starter sheet layouts for the Standard, USAT, and NYT formats.

versions.summary: Headless preview regeneration for launcher and cleanup tools

items: Added a direct preview regeneration helper that rebuilds .preview.png files from saved JSON data without opening a layout editor window.
Updated the main launcher, template editor, regular editor, and Cleanup Layouts dialog to use headless preview regeneration for manual and bulk preview rebuilds.
Removed obsolete temporary-window preview regeneration code paths from the UI build where they were no longer needed.
Fixed preview regeneration actions that still flashed a layout editor window when rebuilding individual previews or regenerating all previews from the cleanup tool.

versions.summary: Adjusted font for printed layout to improve readability

items: Adjusted the font used in the printed layout to improve readability and ensure that all text is clear and legible when printed.

versions.summary: Fix layout issues in printed output

items: Resolved an issue where the layout of the printed output was not displaying correctly.

versions.summary: Add legend and color page list to printed layout

items: Added a legend to the printed layout to provide context for the page list.
Added a color page list to the printed layout.
Updated the layout of the printed output to accommodate the new legend and color page list.
Improved the styling of the printed layout for better readability.

versions.summary: Press and format conversions in layout editor

items: Press and format conversions in layout editor.
Fixed a bug where change tracking in the layout editor was not working correctly causing the save changes dialog to trigger even when no changes were made.

versions.summary: Fixed page count calculation in layout editor

items: Corrected the page count calculation in the layout editor.

versions.summary: Changes New Layout window to a treeview with filters

items: The New Layout window now uses a treeview to display available layouts, allowing for better organization and easier navigation.
Added filter options to the New Layout window, enabling users to quickly find specific templates and layouts.
Layout editor now calculates the page counts for the sections automatically.

versions.summary: Adds launcher version loading from changelog.json and a clickable changelog history view.

items: The main launcher now pulls its version number from changelog.json.
Clicking the version label opens the changelog history dialog.
Updated changelog storage to keep multiple versions in one file.
Added a compact changelog view with collapsible version sections.

versions.summary: Initial release of the Press Layout launcher.

items: Initial consolidated launcher UI for Press Layouts.
Layout browsing, filtering, and preview support.

distribution.notes: Press Layouts launcher uses this block plus current_version to locate and cache the active onedir release.
